title: GoodTime
description: Let server wish players a good time.
body:
# About
The plugin greets the player with a message that corresponds to the time of day in the player's local time zone. For example, if a player has time 9:00, the plugin will show a message by the `messages.goodMorning` path in config.

Default configuration can be found [here](https://github.com/AlekseyVideman/GoodTime/blob/main/src/main/resources/config.yml).


# Installation
1. Put plugin into plugins folder.
2. Download GeoLite2-City database from [here](https://github.com/8bitsaver/maxmind-geoip).
3. Put the database to the plugins/GoodTime folder.
4. Then (re-)start server.

# Reqruirements
1. Paper or its forks.
2. Java 21 minimium.
